story:
[emotion:QT/happy] Ethan ran into the library because he had found the most incredible thing — a huge, colorful puzzle of his favorite video game character, Red Robot. The box showed Red Robot standing on a tall, rocky mountain, holding a glowing treasure chest.

Ethan spread the pieces across the wide table and started building. First, he found the three shiny red pieces for the robot's chest. Then he searched for the round, yellow wheels. After a long while, though, he realized one important piece was missing. [emotion:QT/sad] "I think it fell under the chair," said Maya, a girl sitting nearby. "I saw it while I was reading."

Maya reached under the chair and gave Ethan the small, triangular piece that had the robot's bright green thumb.

[emotion:QT/happy] "That's the one!" Ethan said, his voice warm with relief.

They worked together, taking turns placing pieces until Red Robot was finally whole, standing on his rocky mountain, ready for his next quest. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan thought the finished puzzle looked even better because Maya had helped him. [emotion:QT/happy]

scenes: Ethan runs into a library holding a large, colorful puzzle box featuring Red Robot standing on a rocky mountain with a glowing treasure chest.
Ethan spreads puzzle pieces across a wide table, building the puzzle, while Maya sits nearby reading and points out a missing piece under the chair.
Maya reaches under the chair and hands Ethan a small triangular puzzle piece showing the robot's bright green thumb, as Ethan reacts with relief.
Ethan and Maya sit together at the table, taking turns placing puzzle pieces until the completed Red Robot puzzle is finished and whole.

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan and his Red Robot puzzle?
questions.correct_answer: Working together makes things even better
wrong_answers: Puzzles are too hard to finish alone
Libraries are the best place to find treasure

questions.question: After Ethan found the three red chest pieces, what did he search for next while building the puzzle?
wrong_answers: The robot's bright green thumb piece

questions.question: Where was the missing puzzle piece that Maya saw while she was reading her book?
wrong_answers: On the floor near the door

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan felt that the finished Red Robot puzzle looked even better than he thought it would?
questions.correct_answer: Because Maya helped him finish it together
wrong_answers: Because the robot's green thumb was his favorite part
Because the rocky mountain looked three times bigger

questions.question: What do you think would have happened if Maya had not reached under the chair to give Ethan that triangular piece?
questions.correct_answer: Red Robot's puzzle would have stayed unfinished
wrong_answers: Ethan would have found three more replacement pieces
The library would have had another robot puzzle to try

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to accept Maya's help with the puzzle?
questions.correct_answer: Asking a friend for help makes hard things much easier to finish.
wrong_answers: Solving a puzzle by yourself teaches you more than solving it with others.
Visiting the library often helps you find the things you are looking for.

questions.question: What can you learn from their behavior?
questions.correct_answer: Taking turns and working together gets you to the finish line faster.
wrong_answers: Letting one person lead the way is the best method for finishing a big task.
Watching someone else work on a project helps you learn new skills quickly.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Friendships grow when you share a challenge and solve it side by side.
wrong_answers: Spending time in quiet places like libraries is the best way to make new friends.
Giving someone a gift is the kindest way to show that you care about them.

takeaways: Asking a friend for help makes hard things much easier to finish.
Taking turns and working together gets you to the finish line faster.
Friendships grow when you share a challenge and solve it side by side.
